notes.shape: A claim record whose Claim sentence is a light edit of two source sentences, followed by one local consequence, with a Source line naming the anchored section, a checked date and a revisit trigger.
notes.carve_outs: None needed; the criteria clear it.
notes.rubric: C1 and C2 hold on the Claim's first two sentences. C3 FAILS: the Source line is claim-scoped, names the section, dates the read and states the trigger. C4 FAILS narrowly: the closing sentence draws the cross-boundary consequence the source does not state. C3 alone decides the verdict.
notes.measured: fingerprint.mjs at k=5 against its source.md: containment 0.230, jaccard 0.161, longest matched span 25 words; the separation rule fires. Case and source each stay below both limbs against the real passage's file and its real source (highest containment 0.005, longest span 5 words).
notes.carries: A near-verbatim claim inside its own stamped record. A run that flags it has read the copied words without reading the record beside them.
